title: The category of sheaves of the coarser topology is a weak Serre subcategory and R epsilon_* is an equivalence on bounded below complexes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)

difficulty_reason: The lemma is the general cohomological descent statement for the comparison of two topologies: A_X is a weak Serre subcategory and R epsilon_{X,*} : D^+_{A_X} -> D^+_{A'_X} is an equivalence (statement lines 7360-7373). The proof (proof lines 7375-7422) verifies the weak Serre axioms by transporting kernels, cokernels and extensions along epsilon_{X,*} and epsilon_X^{-1}, and then invokes the equivalence criterion for bounded below derived categories, the hypotheses (V_n) for all n having been provided by the V-C lemma. H2: a verification of standard axioms followed by one application of the equivalence criterion.
